## What landed

- **AR-20 docs-first (commit `aeb3ae0e`, stage 1):** ADR-0437 — the
  two-set closed membership + `set_digest` scheme, the export/load/
  verify argv shapes, `identity.infrastructure.set_digest` +
  `identity.h_set` (§3.3 additive codec), the build-once pass-level
  rebuild gate, the redistribution-aware `digest_only` rule, the
  `hf`/`huggingface_hub` `2.4.0` admission (the AR-15 `gcloud`
  precedent), `hf-upload.sh`'s refusals + token handling, the
  three-tier REQ-XH-103 scan, read-back + supersession + the
  REQ-XH-107 remediation order. `BACKLOG.csv` BL-47 sources +=
  ADR-0437 (before trigger regen); `REVISIT_TRIGGERS.md` +
  `docs/adr/README.md` regenerated.
- **Stage 1 — BINARY-SETS (`aeb3ae0e`):**
  - `crates/hh-runner/src/carried.rs` — `INFRA_SET_MEMBERS` /
    `H_SET_MEMBERS` closed tables; `set_digest` (`sha256:` over the
    canonical member map — CC1 canonicalizer) + `set_manifest`
    (`hh-binary-set/1`); `BinarySetRecipe.render()` — one pinned
    Containerfile (`FROM` digest-pinned toolchain, `ARG
    HH_WORKSPACE_COMMIT`, `cargo build --release --locked -p …`,
    member copies + `sha256sum` manifest); `ExportPlan` — `podman
    save --format oci-archive` / `oci-dir` + `base_blobs` / `tar -cf`
    argv, `run_export` (spawn + log + `hh-carried-export/1` `{argv,
    sha256, bytes, elapsed_ms, base_blobs}` + `egress_line` REQ-XH-118
    input `artifact_export:<role>:<name>`) + `index_entry` through
    R6.12's `artifact_entry` codec (X-04); `LoadPlan` — `gcloud
    compute scp --tunnel-through-iap` + one `gcloud compute ssh
    --command` per VM act (`podman load`/`tar -xf`, base-blob
    re-pulls, `podman image inspect --format {{.Id}}`), `run_load` +
    `hh-carried-load/1` `{scp_argv, vm_commands, image_id,
    elapsed_ms, verified}`; `image_id_normalize` (config-digest only —
    a `name@sha256` RepoDigest is never the identity) +
    `verify_image_id` → `AdmissionReason::HarnessLayerMismatch`
    (the `withheld{admission:harness_layer_mismatch}` surface);
    `carried_rebuild_guard` (gate record `{gate, new_version}`
    required); `artifact_upload_decision` (proprietary/
    source_available → `digest_only` unless an operator
    redistribution record); `ArmLane`/`CarriedSets`/`slot_identity`/
    `check_slot_identity` (W4 slots: one infra-set digest;
    HH-native + V5 also carry `h_set.digest` frozen at `G-L1`).
  - `crates/hh-runner/src/slot_record.rs` — admits
    `identity.infrastructure.set_digest` and a strictly
    member-checked `identity.h_set{digest, frozen_at, hh_kernel, hir,
    compiled_artifacts}` (additive — never required on earlier
    windows).
  - `crates/hh-runner/tests/r6_23.rs` AC-1/AC-2 — RepoDigest refused;
    mismatched image ID → `withheld{admission:harness_layer_mismatch}`;
    rebuild gate; lanes/digests through the strict codec; stub
    podman/gcloud/tar argv pins + sha256 + `elapsed_ms` +
    validator-clean `artifacts[]` for all three roles.
- **Stage 2 — ARCHIVE (b) (`90a1663d`):**
  - `crates/hh-runner/src/archive_upload.rs` — `tool_admission`
    (name/package/version/scope/token-handling); `upload_argv`/
    `download_argv` (upload/download only — `login`/`auth` can never
    appear); `hh-archive-upload/1` receipt + closed
    `validate_upload_receipt` (`private`-only, tool pinned,
    `provided: yes|no` only); `pre_upload_scan` — tier 1/3

    `tombstone_missing` refusals, revoked tokens stay in the raw

  - `scripts/hf-upload.sh` — `upload` refuses `harvest.unverified`

  - `scripts/check-hf-upload.sh` — the fake-shim battery: `hf`

    env file; 31/31 legs (happy-path upload + argv/token/receipt

  - `scripts/live-verify.sh` — `carried-artifacts`
    (`skipped(executes-in-W1-W4-under-R6.32-44-47)`) and
    `archive-upload` (`skipped(executes-per-window-under-R6.40-47)`)

  - `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` — DF-R6.23-1 (V) OPENED.
  - `.github/workflows/ci.yml` — `check-hf-upload.sh` step after

## Deviations / limits

- **Nothing executes for real:** no podman/gcloud/hf, no VM, no HF
  call, no credential, USD $0.00. The export/load/upload host acts are
  stub-shim-pinned argv; `elapsed_ms` records what the shim took, not a
  real W1/W4 measurement — the live legs stay `skipped(executes-*)`
  (R6.32/40/44/45/47 own them).
- **REQ-XH-102's gate-citation predicate** (each paid window's readout
  cites the previous `archive_verified` index) is rowed **DF-R6.23-1**
  — the kit produces the receipts/indexes; the citation is the windows'
  gate readouts (not landed at R6.23).
- **Q-X59 pending:** the purge is *recorded* (`operator_recorded`,
  `pre_authorization` verbatim) — never executed by this row.
- **`hf` upload tool:** `huggingface_hub` `2.4.0` chosen (AR-20 names no
  tool; H1 F7). `hf` CLI 2.x `upload`/`download` verbs + `HF_TOKEN` env,
  no `login` — recorded in ADR-0437.
- **Size:** ~2.5k changed source/test lines vs the ≤1600 trigger — recorded
  (AMEND precedent; two-stage split already applied).
- A stray `.gitignore` `.env` entry (already committed upstream on
  main) collided with a stale stash during work — resolved clean; no
  file lost, both commits intact.
